comment: Panels that are allowed to be empty because this stack gets no special traffic. Each entry: dashboard uid, panel title regex, reason. A panel that is empty and not listed here fails the run.

panels.reason: web server not running: the Next.js server (job crm-web) is not started by this runner
realtime joins need authenticated sockets: the runner connects to /realtime without a session, so no socket reaches the counted state
5xx share needs 5xx errors: none are produced on purpose
failed and retried jobs need failing jobs: the runner only sends jobs that succeed
slow-query watcher and chat bridge are separate services not started by this runner, so crm_slow_query_*, pg_stat_statements_available and crm_chat_bridge_* have no series here
release comparison needs history: it compares this release with one from $compare ago and needs two releases reporting over an hour
